name: Konoike Transport Co.,Ltd.
summary: Konoike Transport Co.,Ltd. engages in logistics business in Japan and internationally. The company also provides value-added services in the steel industry; repair and maintenance services of manufacturing facilities; design, creation, and processing of plant equipment, as well as installation and maintenance work; receiving and preparing raw materials, packaging, and conducting equipment inspection; temperature-controlled logistics services; and support services at airports.
